ai.title: Wall Street holds steadier as chip companies swing back upward
ai.description: Wall Street is holding steadier, as stocks of chip companies and other winners of the artificial intelligence-boom swing back upward on their roller-coaster ride. The S&P 500 rose 0.6% early Monday, coming off its first losing week in the last three and just its third since the end of March. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 190 points, and the Nasdaq composite rose 0.8%. Nvidia rose 1.6% after serving as the heaviest weight on the S&P 500 Friday. AMC Entertainment and Domino's Pizza rose after reporting better-than-expected revenue for the latest quarter. European markets were mixed, and South Korea's Kospi index fell 4.5%.
ai.title_cn: 芯片公司回升，华尔街保持稳定
ai.description_cn: 随着芯片公司和人工智能繁荣的其他赢家的股票在过山车般的旅程中回升，华尔街的股价正在变得更加稳定。标准普尔500指数周一早盘上涨0.6%，结束了过去三周以来的首次下跌，也是自3月底以来的第三周下跌。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨190点，纳斯达克综合指数上涨0.8%。周五，英伟达成为标准普尔500指数中最大的权重股，上涨1.6%。AMC Entertainment和达美乐披萨在报告最新季度收入好于预期后上涨。欧洲市场涨跌互现，韩国综合指数下跌4.5%。
